Name: RIGID_BODY_PARAM_ST
Description: Physics settings for a rigid body: mass, friction, restitution, speed limits, damping, gravity and soft contact behaviour.

Fields.Name: Friction Coefficient
Fields.Description: Friction coefficient of the rigid body surface.

Fields.Name: Restitution Coefficient
Fields.Description: Restitution (bounciness) coefficient of the rigid body.

Fields.Name: Maximum Speed
Fields.Description: Maximum linear speed allowed for the rigid body, in m/s.

Fields.Name: Maximum Angular Velocity
Fields.Description: Maximum angular speed allowed for the rigid body, as an angle per simulation frame.

Fields.Name: Linear Damping
Fields.Description: Linear velocity damping applied to the rigid body. In 1/seconds.

Fields.Name: Angular Damping
Fields.Description: Angular velocity damping applied to the rigid body. In 1/seconds.

Fields.Name: Gravity Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the gravity applied to the rigid body.

Fields.Name: Soft Contact
Fields.Description: The soft contact factor to apply to the rigid body.

Fields.Name: Soft Contact Elasticity
Fields.Description: Elasticity of the rigid body's soft contacts.

Fields.Name: Soft Contact Separation Velocity
Fields.Description: Speed at which soft contacts push bodies apart.

Fields.Name: Soft Contact Force (Soft)
Fields.Description: Soft contact force factor, soft setting.

Fields.Name: Soft Contact Separation Velocity (Soft)
Fields.Description: Speed at which soft contacts push bodies apart, soft setting.

Fields.Name: Soft Contact Force (Hard)
Fields.Description: Soft contact force factor, hard setting.

Fields.Name: Soft Contact Separation Velocity (Hard)
Fields.Description: Speed at which soft contacts push bodies apart, hard setting.
